translations.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
translations.bsb: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
translations.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
translations.asv: Then the earth shook and trembled, The foundations of heaven quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.
